title: Matamshi Bora: (Theme 6: Ukoo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the target sound as one syllable (nya-nya), says it in one beat, and checks it in the word.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels a, e, i, o, u and reads open syllables (ma, me, mi, mo, mu).
floor.question: Soma: ma - ma

representations: clapping one beat for each syllable
a sentence with the sounds: Nyanya alicheza ngoma kwenye sherehe ya ukoo.
steps: Say the word in one go and use it in a sentence.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child says each word on the card and claps its syllables.

misconceptions.ask: Unapiga makofi mangapi kwa neno hili?
misconceptions.repair: "nyota" ina silabi nyo-ta; hakuna irabu ya ziada.

misconceptions.ask: Kuna sauti gani baada ya herufi ya kwanza katika "ngoma"?
misconceptions.repair: Sikiliza tena: "ngoma". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: nya-nya.

misconceptions.ask: Sauti hiyo iko wapi katika neno hili?

checks.question: Ni neno lipi lina sauti lengwa: ngoma au baba?
